title: Tron joins Agentic AI Foundation as founder sees future in AI
summary: Tron has joined the Linux Foundation’s Agentic AI Foundation to collaborate on building open infrastructure for agentic AI, joining Circle and JPMorgan.

title: Bhutan moves $11.8M in BTC from its national stash: Arkham
summary: Bhutan has accumulated around 13,000 Bitcoin since launching state-backed mining operations in 2019, primarily fueled by hydroelectric energy.

title: Vitalik Buterin envisions ‘one-click’ Ether staking for institutions
summary: “We want the authority over staking nodes to be highly distributed, and the first step to doing this is to make it easy,” said Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin.

title: US prosecutors seek Roman Storm retrial after mixed verdict
summary: Manhattan US Attorney Jay Clayton has asked for a date in early October to retry Tornado Cash's Roman Storm on two charges on which a jury previously failed to reach a decision.

title: Wall Street funneled $540M into US Solana ETFs in Q4: Bloomberg
summary: Investment advisors were the biggest buyers of the US-based spot Solana ETFs at over $270 million, while hedge fund managers came in next at $186 million.

title: Sharplink reports $735M loss in 2025 as Ethereum dived
summary: Sharplink says it will continue to acquire Ether despite a brutal crypto market sell-off last year that led to a $616.2 million paper loss on its ETH holdings.

title: Oil tumbles, crypto gains as Trump sends mixed signals over Iran war
summary: “I think the war is very complete, pretty much,” Donald Trump told reporters before posting on his social media platform later that “Death, Fire, and Fury” will reign upon Iran.

title: AI firm Anthropic sues Trump admin over ‘supply chain risk’ label
summary: Anthropic is the first US company the Pentagon has labeled a risk to the military, with the AI company calling it “unprecedented and unlawful.”

title: US banking lobby considers suing OCC over crypto bank charters: Report
summary: The OCC has granted conditional approvals to several crypto firms since December, including BitGo, Ripple, Paxos, and Crypto.com, while others such as Zerohash have filed applications.

title: NFT lending protocol Gondi says platform secured after $230K exploit
summary: Gondi said only the Sell & Repay smart contract was affected and that it is safe to continue buying, selling, trading and listing NFTs on the platform.
